description: This file demonstrates how to animate items within a Kivy RecycleView by using proxy widgets to synchronize animations across recycled items.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A custom Button widget that uses an animation proxy to synchronize opacity animations.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main Kivy App class managing a list of items and handling their animations.

methods.name: update_opacity
methods.description: Synchronizes the opacity property from the proxy widget to the Item.

methods.name: on_animation_proxy
methods.description: Binds or unbinds the opacity property to the proxy widget when the animation_proxy attribute changes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes the data list with 1000 items and loads the KV layout.

methods.name: animate_item
methods.description: Creates a proxy widget and runs an opacity animation on it, updating the data to trigger UI updates.

methods.name: reset_animation
methods.description: Resets the animation_proxy to None after animation completes, allowing garbage collection.
